title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Tropical Pineapple Citrus Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Citrus Ice from the Doozy Seriously Tropical Shortfill collection combines the juicy, sweet taste of pineapple with the zesty, tangy flavour of citrus and a cool ice finish. This e-liquid offers a balanced and refreshing fruit and menthol flavour that’s perfect for vapers who enjoy a mix of sweet, tangy, and cool notes. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle ensures your favourite e-liquid goes the distance, with 20ml of free space for the addition of nicotine shots to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits, mods, and sub-ohm tanks. Doozy Vape Co., based in the UK, are renowned for creating high-quality e-liquids in a staggering variety of exciting flavour profiles you won’t find anywhere else. Their Seriously Tropical collection brings together some of the most vibrant and tropical exotic fruit blends for a sweet, satisfying and sunny vaping experience. Discover the rest of the Seriously Tropical range at Vapestore and find your new favourite flavour today.
